answers.core: It's a natural extension of the existing functionality and users that are familiar with bbcode would already expect this to be possible.
answers.workaround: It can be worked around by using [RichTextLabel.add_image()](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_richtextlabel.html#class-richtextlabel-method-add-image) every time you add an image to a RichTextLabel, but that's not convenient for most cases.

title: Let RichTextLabel's bbcode allow alt text for images when using [img] tag
